newsitem.title: USA: Oilgear Q2 hurt by customer project delays.
newsitem.headline: Oilgear Q2 hurt by customer project delays.

text.p: Oilgear Corp said Thursday second quarter earnings were hurt by delays in customer programs.
"Several major projects were delayed by customers, causing a delay in our shipments," David Zuege, chief executive officer, said. "We anticipate that these systems will be shipped this year."
Incoming orders were up 18 percent from the second quarter of 1996 and 14 percent for the first half, increasing the backlog to nearly $27 million, the company said.

For the second quarter ended June 30, the manufacturer of fluid power components, systems and electronic controls reported net income of $627,000 or $0.50 a share, compared with $673,000 or $0.56 in the same period of 1996.
Oilgear shares were unchanged at 18 Thursday.
